mapper.select: select count(CASE WHEN p.proj_flag = 'W' THEN 1 END) as proj_flag_w, count(CASE WHEN p.proj_flag = 'C' THEN 1 END) as proj_flag_C, count(CASE WHEN p.proj_flag = 'P' THEN 1 END) as proj_flag_P, count(CASE WHEN p.proj_flag = 'E' THEN 1 END) as proj_flag_E from bnc_project p

SELECT rdate as memb_rdate, COALESCE(cnt, 0) cnt FROM ( SELECT TO_CHAR(s, 'YYYYMM') AS rdate FROM generate_series( TO_DATE(#{criteriaMonth}, 'YYYYMM'), TO_DATE(#{curMonth}, 'YYYYMM'), INTERVAL '1 month' ) s ) dt LEFT JOIN ( SELECT SUBSTR(memb_rdate,1,6) as mrdate, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM bnc_member WHERE memb_rdate >= #{criteriaMonth} GROUP BY SUBSTR(memb_rdate,1,6) ) mc ON dt.rdate = mc.mrdate ORDER BY rdate DESC

SELECT p.proj_req_biznum, cm.cmpy_company_name, count(*) as cnt, sum(ct.cntr_price) as totalPrice FROM bnc_project p, bnc_contract ct, bnc_company cm WHERE proj_flag = 'E' AND p.proj_req_biznum IS NOT NULL AND p.proj_number = ct.cntr_proj_number AND p.proj_req_biznum = cm.cmpy_biznum GROUP BY p.proj_req_biznum, cm.cmpy_company_name ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT p.proj_acp_biznum, cm.cmpy_company_name, count(p.proj_number) as cnt, sum(ct.cntr_price) as totalPrice FROM bnc_project p, bnc_contract ct, bnc_company cm WHERE proj_flag = 'E' AND proj_acp_biznum IS NOT NULL AND p.proj_number = ct.cntr_proj_number AND p.proj_acp_biznum = cm.cmpy_biznum GROUP BY p.proj_acp_biznum, cm.cmpy_company_name ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
select round(avg(c.cntr_price)) as avg from bnc_contract c, bnc_project p where p.proj_flag = 'E' and c.cntr_proj_number = p.proj_number
select count(*) as cnt from bnc_member
select count(*) as cnt from bnc_company

SELECT p.proj_number, p.proj_name, p.proj_req_biznum, p.proj_acp_biznum, c.cntr_price FROM bnc_project p, bnc_contract c WHERE p.proj_number = c.cntr_proj_number AND cntr_flag = 'Y' ORDER BY c.cntr_price DESC LIMIT 1
select sum(cntr_price) total from bnc_project p, bnc_contract c where p.proj_number = c.cntr_proj_number and c.cntr_flag = 'Y'
